# Scaled Dimensions

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Accessibility

Increase the text size and compare a fixed icon dimension with a value scaled relative to the same body text style.

- Before: Icon dimensions stay fixed
- After: Icon scales with text

APIs: `@ScaledMetric`, `dynamicTypeSize`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 17+. Present ScaledDoExample() in your app.
struct ScaledDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    @State private var resetID = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            ScaledDoContent(phase: phase)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320, minHeight: 180)
                .id(resetID)
            Button("Run example") { phase += 1 }

            Button("Reset") { phase = 0; resetID += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct ScaledDoContent: View {
    let phase: Int

    var body: some View {
        ScaledDoRow()
            .dynamicTypeSize(phase.isMultiple(of: 2) ? .large : .accessibility2)
    }

}

struct ScaledDoRow: View {
    // excerpt:start
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var iconSize = 24.0

    var body: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .center) {
            Image(systemName: "bell")
                .resizable().scaledToFit()
                .frame(width: iconSize, height: iconSize)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
            Text("Reminder").font(.body)
        }
    }
    // excerpt:end
}
```
